mapper.select: select log_id, tenant_id, status, operate_time, operate_by, reason from hc_customer_status_log where IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted,0)=0 order by operate_time desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hc_customer_status_log (log_id, tenant_id, status, operate_time, operate_by, reason, is_deleted) VALUES (#{logId}, #{tenantId}, #{status}, #{operateTime}, #{operateBy}, #{reason}, 0)
